diffs.diff: distance_cm: datasheet reading gives 0.017 per count, the part's model has none
diffs.evidence: The AJ-SR04M user manual (Mode 1, R19 open, 'Compatible market HR-04 trigger mode') shows a '>10us TTL' trigger and an 'Output echo signal' that stays high for the 'Distance height' (the round-trip time of the 40 kHz burst); it gives no other scaling. The model does carry this conversion, just not as a measure/scale field the gate parses: sim.echo.usPerCm = 58.3 and the driver returns t / 58.3 (US_PER_CM = 2 / 343 m/s), i.e. 1/58.3 = 0.01715 cm per us of echo. The second reading's 0.017 cm per count (count = 1 us) is the same speed-of-sound/2 conversion (340 m/s / 2 = 0.017 cm/us), less than 1% different. The two are equivalent, so the model needs no change.
